Through this program, you will learn about our technology, networks, products, processes, and customer service practices together with your cohort.
cond_0423.responsibilities:
Coordinate with team members on the design, installation, and maintenance of fiber optic cable systems and equipment in data centers and offices.
Work alongside project teams using systems such as SAP, MS Office Applications, Autocad, and/or Microstation to plan, manage, and document OSP projects.
Collaborate with colleagues to manage budgets, order materials, process invoices, and resolve issues related to OSP projects.
Support work with networking optical hardware, such as transponders, amplifiers, switches, routers, and servers.
Work with the team to troubleshoot and resolve network issues, such as outages, performance degradation, and configuration errors.
Build and maintain relationships with business partners, customers, and vendors.
Coordinate maintenance requests and help ensure timely completion of work orders.
Share responsibility across multiple disciplines as part of a cross-functional team.
cond_0423.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
High School Diploma
Working knowledge of Microsoft Office software applications
Strong verbal and written communication skills
Strong analytic and presentation skills
Ability to work well independently or within a group
Willingness to travel to different locations as needed
Comfortable working in an outside environment
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Telecommunications, or related field
Knowledge of fiber optic network principles, standards, and best practices
Certification or training in fiber optic technology, such as CFOT, CFOS, or FOA
cond_0423.values: We value achievement, high standards, and work that is carried out with real discipline. We believe strong organizations are defined by the quality of what they deliver.
